findings.mechanism: functools.lru_cache on the method category_totals is a class-level cache keyed on (self, account, month); it pins the ReportBuilder and cached tuples of totals.
findings.cause: lru_cache on instance method (looks suspicious, but maxsize=128)
findings.evidence: Ran 6 x 4000 synthetic requests via reports.load.run with tracemalloc: cache currsize stays at 128 (maxsize), traced memory flat at ~147-150KB after gc (drift of a few hundred bytes per 4000 requests, not proportional to requests or distinct keys). Cache is bounded.
findings.discriminator: cache_info().currsize plateaus at maxsize=128 and traced heap stays flat across 24000 requests with 19200 distinct keys; entries are small tuples.

findings.mechanism: ReportBuilder._columns lists are per-instance buffers appended during render.
findings.evidence: render() calls column.clear() on every list at the start of each request, so size is bounded by rows per month (28); heap measurement above stayed flat.
findings.discriminator: clear() at builder.py:29-30 resets the buffers each request.
